# Background themes

All four user-supplied images are copied without editing, at their original 1500×2668 resolution.

| Theme | Runtime file | Supplied source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 沙漠落日 | desert.png | Word tiles（闫祺）_slices (3)/bg@2x.png |
| 碧湖森林 | lakeside.png | Word tiles（闫祺）_slices (1)/bg_1@2x.png |
| 薰衣草田 | lavender.png | Word tiles（闫祺）_slices (1)/bg_2@2x.png |
| 雪山冰湖 | snow.png | Word tiles（闫祺）_slices (1)/bg_3@2x.png |

The theme picker changes only the shared CSS background. Settlement foreground layers and game session state are independent of this setting.
